title: Add reusable delete transaction journal contract
description: Design and implement the crash-recovery journal contract required to delete a reusable definition while detaching it from every referencing task atomically. Add a versioned .wtp/meta/reusable-update.json document with prepared and committed states, exact before/after catalog snapshots, exact before/after snapshots for every affected task, deterministic validation, and explicit target paths. Reuse established atomic replacement and fault-point patterns without coupling this journal to the existing batch-update journal. Reject malformed, stale, path-escaping, duplicate-target, or internally inconsistent journals before any recovery action. Add codec and validation tests for empty and multi-status detach sets, state transitions, corrupt input, and Windows/Unix path handling. This task establishes the journal state machine and helpers only; publication and startup recovery are separate dependent tasks.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Started reusable delete journal contract work. I will add an isolated versioned codec/validator and focused tests only; no deletion publication or startup recovery.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Implemented an isolated v1 .wtp/meta/reusable-update.json contract in internal/provider/flatfile/reusable_update_journal.go. It stores base64 byte-exact before/after catalog and task snapshots at canonical root-relative targets; strictly rejects duplicate/unknown JSON properties, malformed snapshots, stale endpoints, omitted live references, escaping/symlink paths, duplicate task targets, and any change beyond deleting one catalog definition plus ordered task detachment/updatedAt advancement. Empty and multi-status detach sets are supported. The helper uses the existing atomic byte replacement path; no publication or startup recovery was wired.
